title: Mission & District Rod & Gun Club
specs: Facilities for multiple shooting disciplines including Cowboy Action, Archery, Rifle, Pistol, Shotgun, Multi-gun
Guests must register at the clubhouse and purchase a guest pass
Rifle range allows rounds up to .338 Lapua Magnum template; 50 BMG prohibited
Shotgun slugs allowed only for sighting in; no buckshot or birdshot on rifle range
Private club open only to members and their guests
includes: Range access for members and guests with guest pass
Use of shooting benches and prone boards on rifle range
gap: Membership fees and how to join not stated
blurb: The club offers facilities for Cowboy Action, Shotgun, Archery, Rifle, Pistol, and Multi-gun shooting. It is a private club open only to members and their guests. The club promotes conservation, sportsmanship, and education in handling sports equipment.
extraNote: Guests must wear guest pass at all times and sign in at each range · Shooting hours vary by range; rifle range closes at sunset or 9pm whichever is first · No steel targets on rifle range; only commercial .22 spinner targets allowed · Rapid semi-auto fire allowed if muzzle is controlled and shots impact berm · Clubhouse at 33154 1st Ave, Mission, BC
